title: withOutputSuffix splits on last '.' in whole path, not basename
detail: bun-apps/pi-agent-flux2/src/scenePipeline.ts withOutputSuffix() computes dot = output.lastIndexOf('.') over the FULL path, not just the filename. If a parent directory segment contains a dot (e.g. options.output="/out.v2/render", no extension on filename) with scenePipeline.seeds set, the per-seed suffix (e.g. "_seed5") gets spliced into the middle of the directory name instead of before the filename extension, producing a nonexistent output dir like "/out_seed5.v2/render". Verified directly: {output:"/out.v2/render"} -> {output:"/out_seed5.v2/render"}. Fix: split only on the basename (path.basename/path.dirname or lastIndexOf('/') then '.').

title: runFlux2 can report post-repair output path with pre-repair gate verdict
detail: bun-apps/pi-agent-flux2/src/index.ts runFlux2(): finalOutput picks pipeline.handRepair?.output ?? pipeline.winnerOutput (post-repair image when repair succeeded), but gate falls back independently via pipeline.handRepair?.gate ?? <pre-repair candidate gate> ?? null. If hand-repair's own gate --json sub-call fails to parse (buildImageDetails/gateImage returns null on any parse failure) while the repair render itself succeeded, the reported Flux2Details couples the NEW image path with the OLD (pre-repair) gate verdict -- misleading any accept/reject decision downstream. Fix: derive output and gate from the same source object atomically (never mix ?? chains across two different result objects).

title: Winner gate re-derived via candidates.find(seed===winnerSeed) instead of reusing pickWinner's chosen object
detail: bun-apps/pi-agent-flux2/src/index.ts's gate: line re-looks-up the winner by seed value (pipeline.candidates.find(c => c.seed === pipeline.winnerSeed)) rather than reusing the actual winning candidate object pickWinner() already selected. Nothing in scenePipeline.ts/the extension validates or dedupes scenePipeline.seeds, so duplicate seeds (e.g. [9,9]) can produce two candidates with the same seed but different gate results; .find() returns the FIRST match (may be the losing one) even though pickWinner correctly tracked the actual best candidate object. Fix: thread the winning candidate object itself through the result instead of re-deriving it by seed lookup.

title: assertPathAllowed accepts a path if EITHER pre-symlink abs OR resolved real path is under an allowed root (OR instead of requiring real-path confinement)
detail: bun-apps/pi-agent-flux2/src/paths.ts assertPathAllowed() uses under(real,root) || under(abs,root) instead of requiring the resolved (real) path to be confined. A symlink planted inside any allowed root (e.g. writable outputDir) can point anywhere on disk (e.g. ~/.ssh/id_rsa) and still validate, because abs (the symlink's own location) is under an allowed root even though real (its target) is not. Reproduced directly: a symlink under outputDir pointing outside repoRoot/outputDir/modelsRoot was accepted instead of throwing. This is a path-traversal / arbitrary file read-or-write escape via staged symlinks. Fix: require under(real, root) unconditionally (only check the resolved path).

title: looksPathy heuristic misclassifies short tokens like ".." as non-path scalars, skipping assertPathAllowed
detail: bun-apps/pi-agent-flux2/src/paths.ts validateExtraArgs()'s looksPathy heuristic (tok.includes('/') || (tok.includes('.') && tok.length > 4)) returns false for ".." (no slash, dot-count check fails length>4), so tokens like ["--output",".."] or ["--models-root",".."] skip assertPathAllowed entirely -- only the leading-dash rejectFlagLike check runs, which ".." also passes. Confirmed by direct repro: validateExtraArgs returned ["--output",".."] unchanged. Since flux2 is spawned with cwd:roots.repoRoot, this resolves outside every allowed root, letting extraArgs write/redirect outside the sandbox. Fix: always run assertPathAllowed on the value token for any allow-listed path-flag, regardless of the looksPathy short-circuit.

title: validateOptionPaths flag-injection guard only checks typeof v === 'string', silently skipping array-typed non-path fields like scene/style's lora: string[]
detail: bun-apps/pi-agent-flux2/src/index.ts validateOptionPaths()'s second loop (rejectFlagLike guard for non-isPath fields) only runs when typeof v === 'string'. Fields declared as string arrays but NOT marked isPath/isPathArray -- concretely lora: string[] on scene/style commands -- are skipped entirely, so an element beginning with '-' (e.g. lora:["legit-lora","--models-root"]) is never checked before buildArgs() emits it as its own argv token. Confirmed by repro: buildArgs produced [...,"--lora","legit-lora","--lora","--models-root"] unrejected. Fix: iterate array elements too when the field is a string array, regardless of isPath status.

title: EXTRA_ARG_ALLOW contains "style-prompt"/"reference-image" which are not real flux2 flags on any command
detail: bun-apps/pi-agent-flux2/src/index.ts EXTRA_ARG_ALLOW allow-lists "style-prompt" and "reference-image", verified against every command's --help output to not exist as real flags. style's override field is actually --prompt (Swift StyleCommand.swift @Option prompt); verify-edit's image field is --image (commands.ts already maps referenceImage -> --image). These look like stale camelCase-derived guesses rather than real flags -- dead allow-list entries widen the extraArgs escape hatch for tokens flux2 never accepts and mislead future readers. Should be pruned; when adding new EXTRA_ARG_ALLOW entries, verify against the actual Swift --help output, not the field's camelCase name.

title: EXTRA_ARG_ALLOW is missing "images", the real --images flag for the edit command
detail: bun-apps/pi-agent-flux2/src/index.ts EXTRA_ARG_ALLOW omits "images" even though --images is edit's real, fully-modeled flag (confirmed live via `flux2 edit --help` and commands.ts's own images field). Calling command:"edit" with extraArgs:["--images","..."] throws PathSafetyError: flag "--images" is not allow-listed, even though it's legitimate. It is the one modeled flag that fell out of sync with EXTRA_ARG_ALLOW -- whenever commands.ts gains/renames a flag, EXTRA_ARG_ALLOW must be updated in the same change.

title: edit command's images field declared isPath:true but Swift --images actually takes ONE comma-separated multi-path string
detail: bun-apps/pi-agent-flux2/src/commands.ts declares edit's images field isPath:true (single-path semantics), but EditCommand.swift does images.split(separator:",") -- the flag takes one comma-joined string of multiple ref paths. index.ts validateOptionPaths calls assertPathAllowed(String(v),...,{mustExist:true}) on the WHOLE comma-joined string, so a genuine multi-ref call like "/repo/a.png,/repo/b.png" fails existsSync() on the literal concatenated string and is rejected with PathSafetyError -- the documented multi-ref use case cannot pass validation at all. Meanwhile a single-path value skips any per-path check a comma-joined string's 2nd+ path might need. Fix: model this field as isPathArray with a comma-split, not isPath.

title: Unguarded awaits in scenePipeline's per-seed loop / VLM verify / hand-repair rerender throw away already-completed work on any failure
detail: bun-apps/pi-agent-flux2/src/scenePipeline.ts has three unguarded await call sites with no try/catch: (1) runSceneOnce inside the per-seed render loop -- can throw synchronously from validateOptionPaths/PathSafetyError or swift build failures unrelated to the flux2 CLI exit code, aborting the whole loop and discarding already-rendered+gated earlier-seed candidates; (2) askAboutImage VLM verification -- pi-vlm's askImage (bun-apps/pi-vlm/src/vlm/ask.ts) only wraps session.prompt in try/catch, NOT readFileSync(abs) or createSharedSession, so a not-yet-flushed image or LM Studio being down throws instead of resolving {ok:false}, propagating uncaught through vlm.ts's askAboutImage (which adds no defensive catch of its own) and killing the entire multi-seed pipeline; (3) the post-winner hand-repair rerender -- by this point winnerSeed/winnerOutput/candidates are already fully valid, but a crash/rejection here discards the entire ScenePipelineResult instead of degrading gracefully to the already-found winner with handRepair:null. Fix: wrap each of these three call sites in try/catch and degrade to partial-progress results (mark ok:false for that seed/step) rather than letting the pipeline throw.

title: Live e2e baseline (LM Studio available): t2i/upscale-chain/scene-pipeline(no-vlm)/scene-pipeline(vlm)/gate all PASS
detail: With lmStudioAvailable=true, all 5 live-e2e steps returned ok:true: t2i (gate=PASS), upscale-chain (gate=PASS), scene-pipeline-no-vlm (winnerReason=best-gate, seeds 11&22 both PASS), scene-pipeline-vlm (winnerReason=verify-match, both candidates PASS with matching VLM replies), gate (PASS). Use this as the reference baseline when checking for live-e2e regressions in future runs of this workflow.

title: Contract lane baseline: 64/64 unit tests pass (6 files, 149 expect()), 18/18 commands fully modeled with no CLI-flag drift
detail: testsSummary="64 pass / 0 fail across 6 files (149 expect() calls)"; checkFlagsSummary="18/18 commands fully modeled. No drift. (no warning lines present)". Use as the reference baseline for pi-agent-flux2's contract lane; a drop in pass count or reappearance of drift warning lines signals a regression worth investigating before merging schema/commands.ts changes.
